# Diagnostic facade only: all discovered tests and source validators retain
# their actual tracked module paths. Workers re-exec this private __file__.
HERE = Path(os.environ['LI2_RECORDER_SOURCE_ROOT']).resolve(strict=True) / 'evaluation/admission'
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

def timing_event(event, test):
    # These inclusive timings include result/output bookkeeping. Process CPU
    # excludes descendant CPU; no timing can qualify a test or a repository run.
    row = dict(schema=1, event=event, test=test.id(), pid=os.getpid(),
               affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
               monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns(), process_time_ns=time.process_time_ns())
    print('RECORDER_TIMING ' + json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'),
                                         allow_nan=False), flush=True)


class Ledger(unittest.TextTestResult):

def stopTest(self, test):
        self.completed_ids.append(test.id())
        super().stopTest(test)
        timing_event('stop', test)
